missing: Three refutations. (1) Detection trusts caller-assembled access sets — an unrecorded held-out read reports clean; there is no tracking mechanism to contradict a missing entry (vc_201_009_mastery_unrecorded_access_is_undetectable). (2) Overlap is by fixture id only — byte-identical held-out content present under another id is invisible (vc_201_009_mastery_content_contamination_under_another_id_is_clean). (3) 'Excluded from improvement evidence' is an unconsumed flag — detect() returns a report and no gate or caller excludes the run; eval_contamination has no production caller (vc_201_009_mastery_exclusion_is_a_flag_not_an_exclusion). Holds: a genuine id overlap flags with a reason naming the ids, disjoint sets report clean (vc_201_009_mastery_id_overlap_flags_with_reason).
